text: On the authority of Othman bin Abi Al-Aas, may God be pleased with him, that he complained to the Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, about a pain that he had found in his body since he converted to Islam. The Messenger of God, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, said to him: Place your hand on the part of your body that hurts, and say: In the name of God, three times, and say seven times: I seek refuge in God and His power from the evil of what I find and I beware.
